lesson: Today we work on one technique repetition with a difference that means a word comes back later but changed a little so you hear both times at once watch the word hand first it is where your hand has learned it a thousand times later it is your hand knows the weight of it the pull the swing the word returns but now the hand is doing something new it is not resting on the bench it is opening a door here is why the return works on you when the same word comes back your ear remembers the first time so you measure the second use against the first the change tells you the man has moved from standing still to going out try this pick one plain word use it early then use it again later doing a different action the second time through listen for how hand turns from touching to moving
